_about.enabled: Master switch of every engagement feature. false: none of them starts anything new; what runs is finished or refunded; saves are kept. (default true)
_about.tpScale: Scale on all TP the engagement features pay (after progression/TpScale). (default 1.0, 0.0 to 10.0)
_about.wardrobe.enabled: The Wardrobe: titles on nameplates, canon outfits, nameplate frames, victory poses (cosmetic only). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.wardrobe.zeniShop: Some outfits are sold for Zeni (Bulma's Wardrobe tab, Planet Vegeta's armoury, Roshi). (default true)
_about.wardrobe.poses: Victory poses after a won spar, duel, Budokai bout or raid. (default true)
_about.moments.enabled: Canon Moments: the hidden Ascension chapter of anime moments, the after-fight card, riddles. "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.moments.tpScale: Scale on the small TP a Canon Moment pays once. (default 1.0, 0.0 to 10.0)
_about.featured.enabled: The Featured Fight of the week and the calendar page. "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.featured.weekStartsOn: The day the featured week starts, 00:00 server time (MONDAY ... SUNDAY). (default MONDAY)
_about.featured.pool: Fight ids the weekly pick draws from (empty: every fight that registered itself). (default [])
_about.featured.modifiers: Modifier ids the weekly pick may use (empty: every registered modifier). (default [])
_about.featured.weeklyTp: Base TP of the weekly bonus (first clear of the week, per character, account cap). (default 3000, 0 to 1000000)
_about.featured.weeklyZeni: Zeni of the weekly bonus. (default 2000, 0 to 1000000)
_about.arcs.enabled: Training Arcs under a master (steps, graduation, the master's favour). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.arcs.favourDiscount: TP price cut on that master's own techniques after his arc (0.10 = 10 %). (default 0.1, 0.0 to 0.5)
_about.arcs.weightSurge: Taking weighted gear off mid-fight gives a short speed surge once per fight (never in duels or the Budokai). (default true)
_about.power.enabled: Power Readings and Universe Rankings. "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.power.milestones: Canon power readings read out once as your Battle Power passes them. (default true)
_about.power.rankings: The Universe Rankings boards (daily snapshot). (default true)
_about.power.canonCast: The canon cast at scaled readings fills the boards of small servers and singleplayer. (default true)
_about.power.scouterCrack: The over-9000 reading cracks a scouter in a short staged moment (each player's scene setting still decides). (default true)
_about.codex.enabled: The Scouter Codex (fighters, races, worlds, masters, forms, featured weeks). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.codex.firstFootfall: The first character of the server to land on a world gets its first footfall (and a news line). (default true)
_about.legacy.enabled: Legacy: Codex entries, titles and outfits unlocked by any character of an account stay unlocked for all of them (nothing else carries). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.legacy.accountWide: Legacy items are shared by every character of the account. (default true)
_about.budokai.enabled: The Tenkaichi Budokai circuit (preliminaries, bracket, reigning champion, seasons). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.budokai.everyDays: Real days between two circuits on a server. (default 7, 1 to 60)
_about.budokai.hour: Hour of the day (server time) a circuit starts. (default 19, 0 to 23)
_about.budokai.npcEntrants: Canon NPC entrants fill the bracket. (default true)
_about.budokai.satan: Mr. Satan's exhibition after a final (a comic staged moment, opt-in scenes). (default true)
_about.racial.enabled: Racial Mastery (cosmetic look levels of the racial ability, one challenge per race). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
_about.xs.enabled: The small expansions of existing systems (saga epilogues, travel-event kinds, wish board, ...). "default": on once the feature is finished in this build. (default default, true / false / default)
